input:
Earlier scenes:
古代的时候，有一个男人，他的名字是神农。他看到了有很多人不知道哪个植物好吃，也不知道什么植物对你的身体有好处。这个问题神农觉得很糟糕，所以神农去了吃每种植物。他吃了一种植物以后，就写了这个植物对你有没有好处。有的时候，神农吃了很好吃的植物。有的时候，他吃了很危险的植物。他吃完了每种植物以后，会来跟他的朋友聊到他吃的植物了。

This scene:
一个人问神农，哪个植物好吃。神农说，这就要看你的口味了。要是你喜欢吃甜的，有很多甜的水果，比方说苹果、西瓜和梨。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有好处。神农说，有很多种植物对你的身体有好处，比方说小白菜、黄瓜、茶和菠菜。一个别的人问神农，哪个植物对你的身体有坏处。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一个别的人问神农：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 一个别的人问神农：第三个人

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use 种 when asking which type of plant in a general category. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 这就要看你的口味了：这就要看你喜欢什么口味了，The structure 这就要看……了 needs a question form after 看, such as a wh-question. [rule: zhe_jiu_yao_kan]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个别的人：另一个人，别的 distinguishes other people from a stated group; here the speaker means one additional person, so 另一个人 fits. [teacher rule: bieren]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use 种 when asking which type of plant in a general category. [rule: none]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一个别的人：另一个人，别的 distinguishes other people from a stated group; here the speaker means one additional person, so 另一个人 fits. [teacher rule: bieren]
6. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 哪个植物：哪种植物，Use 种 when asking which type of plant in a general category. [rule: none]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 对你的身体有好处：对身体有好处，This is a general fact about plants, so the addressee pronoun is unnecessary and can make the benefit sound limited to one unidentified person. [rule: reference_form]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 对你的身体有坏处：对身体有坏处，This is also a general statement, so removing the pronoun keeps the reference broad and clear. [rule: reference_form]

items.reason: 哪个植物 is acceptable here, although 哪种植物 is often more natural when asking about types.
这就要看你的口味了 is already a correct use of the 这就要看……了 structure.
别的人 is not appropriate for introducing one additional person; 另一个人 correctly fixes it.
哪个植物 is acceptable here, though 哪种植物 is a possible more specific wording.
This is the third questioner, so the teacher-required clear reference is 第三个人 rather than another 另一个人.
哪个植物 is not an error in this question, even if 哪种植物 is also possible.
你的 is a natural generic addressee reference in this dialogue and does not limit the statement improperly.
你的 is likewise acceptable as generic reference in the question about harmful plants.
